title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: The Red Sox won 12-11 against the White Sox in a 13-inning game, marking their eighth consecutive victory.
Caleb Durbin delivered a walk-off RBI single, scoring Nick Sogard, sealing the win after five Red Sox comebacks.
Pitcher Ranger Suárez struggled, allowing three earned runs in three innings, as the game saw a total of 17 pitchers.

title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown's performance at Patriots' training camp has improved, becoming a key target for quarterback Drake Maye.
Marcus Bryant and Gabe Jacas have emerged as key players at their positions during Patriots' training camp.
Kyle Williams and Caleb Lomu are struggling, with Williams slipping to the third-team offense in recent practices.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias, Red Sox's top prospect, is batting .326 with 12 RBIs in 10 games for Triple-A Worcester.
Arias, 20, was recently promoted to Triple-A and is ranked No. 2 prospect by Baseball America.
Red Sox evaluating Arias for potential MLB call-up; current shortstops are Andruw Monasterio and injured Trevor Story.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek help identifying a person who broke into a Jamaica Plain apartment on August 5.
The suspect entered the home on Heath Street by climbing through a bedroom window around 7 a.m.
Described as a Black male in his late teens or early 20s, the suspect wore a white T-shirt and black and white cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner reported front sway bar links breaking at 22,000 miles, suggesting quality issues.
Torx-Plus fasteners are used for stronger and more precise tool fit, suitable for automated assembly processes.
CTEK and Deltran Battery Tender are recommended brands for battery maintainers, varying in price and quality.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions at his first 76ers press conference after being traded from the Boston Celtics.
Brown mentioned he hasn't spoken to former Celtics teammate Jayson Tatum since his trade to Philadelphia.
Joining a strong 76ers roster, Brown acknowledged the team's potential but emphasized the need for hard work and unity.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults were injured in a school bus rollover in Mattapan, Boston on Thursday afternoon, police reported.
The incident occurred near 1000 Harvard St. shortly before 1:10 p.m. with no children on the bus.
Victims were taken to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; the cause of the rollover is unclear.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw three interceptions in a disappointing two-minute drill performance at Patriots training camp.
Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle, replacing the injured Will Campbell, over first-round pick Caleb Lomu.
Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas received first-team reps, marking progress in his training ahead of the preseason opener.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown is closing permanently on November 2 after 21 years of operation.
Owners Viola 'Chach' Briseño and Sharon Bowes cite the demanding nature of the business as a reason for closing.
Chach Restaurant has been acclaimed for its homemade dishes like Eggs Benedict and popular weekly specials.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix's library exceeds 3,500 films, spanning Netflix originals to classic movies from past decades.
Highlighted films include 'Clueless' with Alicia Silverstone and 'Eighth Grade' directed by Bo Burnham.
'Inside Man' and 'The Irishman' are notable films available for streaming on Netflix in August 2026.
